data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 1.8 million on prior year reserves. This has been primarily generated by better than expected claims experience on the property reinsurance class of business.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall prior-year reserve release of GBP 1.8m in 2015, primarily driven by favourable claims experience in its property reinsurance business. This release reduced the opening gross claims outstanding (2014 closing) of GBP 2.395m. The amount reported in the accounts is presented as an overall surplus on prior year reserves in the Technical Provisions note.
raw_causal_phrases: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 1.8 million on prior year reserves.
This has been primarily generated by better than expected claims experience on the property reinsurance class of business.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount used is the explicit narrative surplus of GBP 1.8m quoted in the Technical Provisions / Claims development note. The report does not present a separate labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure; a small gross movement for the 2014 underwriting year can be inferred from the claims development table but the document explicitly describes a GBP 1.8m surplus (release). Therefore the GBP 1.8m has been used (likely presentation is overall / possibly net of reinsurance in narrative) - flagged as taken from narrative. All amounts converted from stated GBP '000 to millions.
